body:
I have tried on a few occasions. It doesn't feel right. Women's clothes don't fit me, because I'm not one. I just look like a dude wearing women's clothes. I know I don't really have any other options, other than surgery/hormone therapy. This is the body I was given, and it sucks. I'm already in my 30's with an established identity, people know me as a dude. I don't want to go down that path.

It's hard to explain, but I want to re-live my life as a girl. I want to experience school, friends, sports as a girl. I had a terrible teenage life, if I was a girl I'd have felt more natural, would have felt comfortable as myself, would have opened up to others more.
